en: Iris
Yahoo! It's you! I haven't seen you since we ran into each other in Castelia City!
Are you here to challenge my grandpa? Yep! Drayden, the Gym Leader of Opelucid City, is my grandpa.
We're not really related, though! Hee hee!
Oh! The Gym is up that way, past the street's end! But before you take it on, you might want to see Route 9 first.
Still, your Pokémon really respect you! I can feel how much fun they're having, even from inside their Poké Balls!
Good luck!
Gentleman
The memories of everyone who has lived in this city have built up over the years without changing much.
Or perhaps this city changes endlessly, and every change is engraved in the memories of the people who live here. I can't decide.
Black Belt
I reached heights I never could have reached alone, because I had Pokémon by my side.
I think some things shouldn't be changed, even if it's inconvenient. And I think some things must be changed no matter how much you love them!
Youngster
A person called N once had a legendary Pokémon with him. But was he really the hero? I keep wondering.
Artist
Opelucid City is a place where the old and the new live side by side. I paint it every morning, and every morning it has changed.
Worker
Drayden is our mayor as well as our Gym Leader! He's always training, wrestling with his Pokémon in the yard of his house.
Backers
Unova's symbols are Zekrom and Reshiram, but I wonder where they are now. Are they passing their ancient knowledge on to someone?
Citizen
There was a group that told people to release their Pokémon. They were great big liars, but it did make us think.
After that speech, my Pokémon and I have been working out what's true for us.
Drayden
There you are. Come along, {player}. My house is the one just ahead, and what I have to tell you is best told sitting down.
This way!
We're here. Come inside.
Drayden
What was that sound? It came from up in the sky!
This world of ice... In one moment the whole city has frozen over!
Haxorus! Use Dragon Tail on the ice!
Haxorus slammed its tail down on the ice. Not even a scratch showed.
Not only did the ice stay unbroken, there isn't even a mark on it. What's going on?
I don't think that will work.
Drayden
I remember you from N's Castle.
Zinzolin
It's bitter cold. I'm shivering. I'm suffering, but I'm alive! This is what the essence of life feels like!
Let me explain our purpose here. Drayden, hand over the DNA Splicers!
Opelucid City is a city where the past and the future are entwined. Surely it is the right place to keep something that bridges the two.
Drayden
Do you think a man who knows what you did two years ago will hand them over quietly?
Zinzolin
Humph. That's what I expected you to say. I would threaten you with another volley of ice, but we can't loose it so soon.
No matter! I have my people searching your city already. I won't leave without what I came for.
Drayden
Those foul villains!
{player}! I want you to help me! We're going to drive Team Plasma out of Opelucid City!
They will go for the Gym sooner or later. I'll wait there. Clear the streets of their grunts and I'll meet you at my Gym's door.
Grunt
Pokémon are pawns! They're a means to an end. That's what I was taught! Don't think about it too much. It's easier that way.
The others were saying that the only place we haven't searched yet is the Pokémon Gym!
How can this be? Is that the kind of power Pokémon have when they're not treated like objects?
Grunt
This time we'll take over the Unova region! You! You're trembling already? From fear or from cold, either's good!
It's not over! The others will find the DNA Splicers! When they do, the Unova region is ours!
Now that you mention it, I think I might have been ordered to comb the Pokémon Gym...
Grunt
Don't get in our way! You bother! Bother, bother, bother!
Zinzolin said to stick close to Drayden, because that's where we'll find anything important!
How humiliating... being bothered by a bother...
Grunt
I think Zinzolin was going to check the Pokémon Gym... Oh, I lost. I didn't stand a chance! I can't believe a Haxorus blasted me all the way over here!
Grunt
I've been nursing a grudge for two years, old man. ...Even if this is the first time I've battled you! Hm? You're not him? That's all right. I'll keep my grudge.
Grunt
Oh, that Drayden! Where did he hide the DNA Splicers? Somewhere familiar and common, right? That old guy won't hold back even if his opponent is a young girl.
Zinzolin
Oh, for crying out loud... I didn't expect to have to fight, hampered by cold like this.
Well, no matter! The fact that you've come this far means the splicers must be inside!
You're a strong Trainer. You are adept at handling Pokémon. I believe I'll take my leave, simply because I'm a little tired.
Drayden
You're even better than I hoped. Thanks to you, we drove them off. Your Pokémon deserve my thanks too.
Wait here a moment. I'll be right back.
Harrumph... that's a new record for making it there and back.
Look, {player}. These are the DNA Splicers!
This is what they were after! We're really fortunate Team Plasma didn't get their hands on them. I still don't know what their goal is, but it can't be good.
Shadow Triad
As we suspected... the hiding place was in the Gym. Well thought out. If Drayden isn't there, we can't get in.
Drayden
It's beyond my imagination to think you'd use one of the Seven Sages to find out where the splicers were!
Shadow Triad
Now you know, then. We will accomplish our goals, no matter what the cost.
We don't have the ability to captivate people. So we will simply take what we need.
Drayden
If they've been stolen from us, we'll just have to take them back!
They will go east, along the road to Route 11. Go after them, {player}! I'll follow as fast as I can!
Shadow Triad
Heh heh... You don't really think you can take the DNA Splicers back, do you?
Awww. How unlucky. I don't happen to be the one holding the DNA Splicers. I was just buying time for the others to get away.
Drayden
Oh no! No, no, it's not your fault, {player}. You were impressive! It's I who let everybody down.
The Xtransceiver is ringing.
{player} picked up the Xtransceiver.
Augh! If there were only two of me! Then I could protect the town and chase after them too!
Cheren
{player}. Drayden, glad to see you're safe as well.
Drayden
Hello, Cheren. You have certainly grown. I hear you filled in for Lenora and became the Gym Leader in Aspertia City.
Cheren
Thanks. We should save catching up for later. I have a good idea of where Team Plasma is hiding. The place with the lowest chance of anyone looking: a city on the sea.
The Frigate went south and east: it's making for Humilau City. {player}, I could use your help, if you're willing. You're a skilled Trainer who can go toe to toe with Team Plasma.
Drayden
Very well. I'll do my part, and thank you. The chase I leave to you! But... don't do anything reckless.
Humilau City, huh... Is there anything to the north of Undella Town? {player}, protect the Pokémon from Team Plasma. Go with my blessing.
Little by little, the ice is starting to melt. It's all thanks to you. As a fellow Trainer, I heartily thank you!
